metadata.title: Finding Your Ancestors' Descendants  - James Tanner (26 Feb 2023)
metadata.author: BYU Library Family History Center
metadata.shortDescription:
Descendancy research opens up a whole new world of genealogical research. All those people who are descendants of your grandparents and great-grandparents and back through all the generations are your cousins and finding them can be as challenging and interesting as following a direct line. Take some time to watch this video about how to get started with finding all those cousins. 
For more information: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/virtual-classes/finding-your-ancestors-descendants
Handout: https://familyhistory.lib.byu.edu/0000018f-a74b-d08a-abaf-bfff074e0001/finding-your-ancestors-descendants-james-tanner-26-feb-2023-pdf
